description: Labeled claim pairs for the supersession check. Each item is what the extraction writer hands the check: an earlier claim and a later one with the same subject and predicate (the only pairs the writer asks about), plus the sentence the later claim was read from. `label` is what must happen: `allow` means the later claim really replaces the earlier one (a move, a new employer, a changed preference, a migration) and cutting the earlier claim is right; `keep` means both can hold, or the later one is a plan or a misreading of the sentence, and cutting the earlier claim would destroy a current fact — every `keep` item is a cut the deterministic writer makes, since it cuts whenever the model says `supersedes`; `ambiguous` means the sentence does not settle it, reported but not gated. `kind` names the case so a figure exists per kind.
